title: Whole Grain Pasta with Cream Sauce and Vegetables, Ready-to-Heat

content.title: About
content.content: Whole grain pasta with cream sauce and added vegetables is a ready‑to‑heat meal that can be quickly warmed in a microwave or on the stovetop. It contains whole‑grain pasta, a smooth cream sauce, and a mix of carrots, broccoli, sweet pepper and zucchini. The dish is balanced in protein, carbohydrates and fiber, making it a convenient option for busy people who want a tasty and nutritious meal.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole grain pasta provides more fiber and B‑vitamins than traditional white pasta.
The cream sauce is made with low‑fat dairy and plant oils, reducing saturated fat content.
Vegetables are flash‑steamed to retain most of their vitamins and minerals.
The product has a shelf life of up to 12 months when stored in a cool, dry place.
Heating takes only 3–5 minutes, ideal for office lunches and travel.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Whole grain pasta supplies dietary fiber that supports healthy digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Vitamins and minerals
items.content: The vegetable blend adds vitamin C, vitamin A, potassium and folate, important for immunity and metabolism.

items.title: Low added sugar
items.content: The meal contains no added sugars, making it suitable for blood‑glucose management.

items.title: Plant‑based protein source
items.content: Combined whole grain pasta and vegetables provide a moderate amount of plant protein.

items.title: Moderate healthy fats
items.content: The cream sauce includes monounsaturated fats that support heart health.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: The cream sauce contains milk; individuals with lactose intolerance or dairy allergy should choose an alternative.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The ready sauce may contain added salt; people monitoring sodium intake should check the label.

items.title: Heat safety
items.content: Insufficient heating can leave bacteria; heat the meal to an internal temperature of at least 75 °C.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: The pasta is wheat‑based and contains gluten; not suitable for those with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat a portion in the microwave (≈3 minutes) or on the stovetop, stirring until hot. Serve as a standalone meal or with a green salad. Optional toppings include grated Parmesan or fresh herbs.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep it in an airtight container and consume within 5 days. Discard if an off‑odor or discoloration develops.
